test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Ramesh runs at the speed of 234 kmph. How many metres does he run in ten minutes?
solution:
Given:

Rames runs at the speed of 234 kmph

Concept used:

1 km / hr = 5 / 18 mt/ sec

Calculation:

So, 234 kmph = (234 × 5)/ 18 mt/ sec

⇒ 65 mt / sec

10 minutes = 600 sec 

⇒ Rames runs 65 meter in 1 sec

So, he runs in 600 sec,

⇒ 65 × 600 = 39000 meter

**∴ The correct option is 2**
